U04-DRIVE-FRAME.selected_frame: subject NOM + drīfan + driven being ACC

U04-DRIVE-FRAME.application_limit: New nīetenu object is semantically ordinary animal-driving, not an exact quotation; no goal preposition assigned.

U04-BIND-FRAME.selected_frame: subject NOM + bindan + bound being ACC
U04-BIND-FRAME.application_limit: New animal object is ordinary lexical application of bind/tie. No means or instrument assigned.

U04-RIDE-FRAME.selected_frame: subject NOM + rīdan, ordinary intransitive riding
U04-RIDE-FRAME.original_minimal_example: Sum mon rád be ðære stówe
U04-RIDE-FRAME.original_locator: Main 795a, s.v. rídan I; Bd.3,9; S.533,30
U04-RIDE-FRAME.application_limit: Only intransitivity and horseback sense used. The prepositional phrase is evidence context, not taught motion syntax. Prior wīde may modify the action.

U04-DRINK-FRAME.application_limit: Water specifically attested; positive drinking-water clause is new composition. No partitive-genitive or convivial sense assigned.

U04-HELP-FRAME.selected_frame: subject NOM + helpan + being helped DAT
U04-HELP-FRAME.application_limit: Dative is the selected classroom frame; genitive also attested. A bird as recipient of help is a declared ordinary semantic application; the source example is human. Do not reject a valid genitive answer as ungrammatical, though it differs from an explicit dative target.

U04-FIND-FRAME.selected_frame: subject NOM + findan + found person/thing ACC
U04-FIND-FRAME.original_locator: Cook p180/PDF196, printed lines5–6; ellipsis is editorial, not a contiguous quotation
U04-FIND-FRAME.application_limit: Finding a ship/dwelling as object is ordinary lexical application; source confirms accusative and preverbal ne, not new relative-clause syntax.

U04-CHOOSE-FRAME.selected_frame: subject NOM + cēosan + chosen person/thing ACC
U04-CHOOSE-FRAME.application_limit: Infinitive occurrence supplies lexical government only; independent infinitive use is unassigned. Choosing a ship/dwelling is a declared ordinary application of choose, not an attested example.

U04-SING-FRAME.selected_frame: subject NOM + singan, ordinary intransitive singing
U04-SING-FRAME.application_limit: No nominal object is required; prior wel may modify. Transitive praise sense and quotation syntax with singan are not promoted.

U04-PRED.selected_frame: subject NOM + ordinary weorðan + agreeing predicate NOM
U04-PRED.application_limit: Source supplies general predicate case rule, using prefixed subjunctive example. Ordinary unprefixed become sense separately verified p321. New indicative+adjective clauses apply the rule; no subjunctive/passive teaching follows.
